_comment: Face recognition of ENROLLED people only (agreed by Gloriana, Tiffany and Kim; see CLAUDE.md). Embeddings live on the hat in faces_dir (git-ignored), made by scripts/faces/enrol.py and deleted by scripts/faces/remove.py. Nothing runs while faces_dir has nobody in it. A name is said only when the best enrolled match has cosine similarity >= match_threshold AND beats the next enrolled person by min_margin; otherwise the person stays 'Person'. match_threshold 0.363 is OpenCV's published cosine threshold for SFace; tune only with the team's agreement (report, do not push). Faces smaller than min_face_px or found with a score below face_min_score are not checked. Each person track is checked at most every check_interval_ms, off the frame path; a name is forgotten name_ttl_ms after its last match. Loaded by device/src/common/config.cpp and scripts/faces/*.py.
